role: Extension defining the unsupportedMetricVerdict Concept (metric-authority, illness-forecast and evidence-superlative phrasing in 17 locales), consumed by CoachVoiceGuard via scrubFromOutput and listed in MedicalTermLexicon.all.
toplevel: One static let Concept with latin alternatives (HF power claims, 'strongly suggests', illness forecasting, 'stay home', 'fully recovered', 'gold standard', ...) and CJK/Arabic unbounded strings.

flags.text: Broad output-scrub alternatives 'stay(?:ing)? home', 'fully recovered', 'is a sign that', 'strongly suggests' rewrite any model sentence containing them into a deflection whether or not a metric verdict is made (e.g. 'stay home and rest if it rains').
